title: Mixing: Mama’s Little Girl, Bridge Over The River Suite by Wings | 1973
content:
Studio Two, EMI Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Richard Lush

Two songs by Wings were mixed on 5 February 1973: ‘Mama’s Little Girl’ and ‘Bridge Over The River Suite’.

Although under consideration for the Red Rose Speedway album, they both received different fates. ‘Bridge Over The River Suite’ was the b-side of the 1974 single ‘Walking In The Park With Eloise’, credited to The Country Hams. ‘Mama’s Little Girl’, meanwhile, remained unreleased until 1990, when it was a b-side of Paul McCartney’s ‘Put It There’ single.
